component.name: PenguinFin
component.summary: Offline planner for bills, expenses, income and investments

description.p: PenguinFin keeps track of your income, bills and recurring expenses, and projects how your cash, investment and retirement balances grow over the years. All data is stored in a local SQLite file and never leaves your computer.

ul.li: Income, bills and recurring expenses with weekly to yearly schedules
Upcoming payments for the next 30 days
Checking, savings, brokerage, 401(k), IRA and HSA accounts with holdings
Multi-decade projections with raises, inflation and expected returns
Savings goals that respect each account's minimum balance
Optional economic data from FRED (inflation, interest rates, market returns)

description.p: Windows build, app icon on the window, and a richer sample household.
Buckets inside accounts (such as Rainy day money), choosing which account or bucket pays each bill, and an Accounts & buckets chart.
Savings goals, plus purposes and minimum balances for accounts.
Optional economic data from FRED: inflation, interest rates and market returns to inform projections.
Faster, more responsive interface; account form adapts to the account type; pages open at the top.
Dropdowns follow the app's light or dark theme instead of the desktop theme.
Interface size control with automatic fit-to-window, natural scrolling, a responsive layout and loading skeletons.
